rules.text: IF PurchaseOrder.amount >= 50000 AND PurchaseOrder.amount < 500000 THEN require manager approval

rules.text: IF PurchaseOrder.amount >= 500000 AND PurchaseOrder.amount < 2000000 THEN require supply-chain VP approval
